name: @scambrake/api
description: NestJS API for ScamBrake: analysis, deterministic policy, PayPal Orders v2 Sandbox, and MCP.

scripts.eval: pnpm --filter @scambrake/contracts build && pnpm build && node dist/evals/cli.js compare --baseline v2-hardened --candidate v4-verbatim-quotes
scripts.eval:compare: pnpm --filter @scambrake/contracts build && pnpm build && node dist/evals/cli.js compare --baseline v1-baseline --candidate v2-hardened
scripts.eval:live: pnpm --filter @scambrake/contracts build && pnpm build && node dist/evals/cli.js compare --live --write-cache --baseline v2-hardened --candidate v4-verbatim-quotes
scripts.eval:record: pnpm --filter @scambrake/contracts build && pnpm build && node dist/evals/cli.js run --live --write-cache --version v1-baseline --version v2-hardened --version v3-quoted-context --version v4-verbatim-quotes
scripts.eval:check: pnpm --filter @scambrake/contracts build && pnpm build && node dist/evals/cli.js compare --baseline v2-hardened --candidate v4-verbatim-quotes --fail-on-gate --require-promotion
scripts.eval:list: pnpm --filter @scambrake/contracts build && pnpm build && node dist/evals/cli.js list
